run_f_gold: run f_gold to find the sum of the three largest elements in an array
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple parameter sets to verify correct maximum triplet sum results
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use Python built-in sorting instead of manual tracking of top three values
review_f_gold: review f_gold algorithm that tracks maxA, maxB, maxC in a single pass over the array
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which returns the sum of the three largest values from the first n elements
